Native PNG: Fakku Store  untouched download. They let you choose between PNG and PDF.
Proper PDF rip: Irodori Store only has PDF. To get the images you must use poppler's pdfimages and then losslessly optimize them with pinga (GUI) or pingo (CLI):

1. Download the latest *poppler* binary [HERE](https://github.com/oschwartz10612/poppler-windows/releases)
2. Extract the **bin** folder from *.zip\Library* and use *pdfimages*.exe inside it with these commands:
`pdfimages.exe -j -png "pdf file path" "output folder path and prefix for img name"`
3. Download, extract and install *pinga* from [HERE](https://css-ig.net/pinga)
4. Run it and change the settings to [THIS](https://imgur.com/a/jtMRVC2) to avoid using lossy conversions.
5. Add the extracted images (both JPGs and PNGs) and hit the *optimize* button. JPGs will be handled losslessly too.
